ai.title: Kioxia, Sandisk plan $31.4 billion Japan investment to boost AI chip output
ai.description: Kioxia and Sandisk will invest over $31.4 billion to increase chip production. This significant investment will occur over the next six years in Japan. A new facility in Kitakami will produce high-density 3D flash memory chips. These chips are essential for managing massive artificial intelligence workloads. The move aims to ease global shortages and reduce electronics costs.
ai.title_cn: Kioxia，Sandisk计划在日本投资314亿美元以提高AI芯片产量
ai.description_cn: Kioxia和Sandisk将投资超过314亿美元来增加芯片产量。这项重大投资将在未来六年内在日本进行。北上的新工厂将生产高密度3D闪存芯片。这些芯片对于管理大量人工智能工作负载至关重要。此举旨在缓解全球短缺并降低电子产品成本。
